map.→ 打开生日悖论计算器工具: -> Open the birthday paradox calculator tool
map.填写「人数 N」。: Fill in "the number of people N".
map.是两两组合爆炸，非单人与全年比。: It is a two-by-two pair explosion, not one person against the whole year.
map.班级点名或抽奖前估算撞生日概率，向同事解释 23 人就有约一半概率重复。: Estimate the birthday collision chance before roll call or a draw, to show colleagues that 23 people already give about a 50% chance of a duplicate.
map.算群体中至少两人生日相同的概率。: Compute the probability that at least two people in a group share a birthday.
map.组合数随人数平方增长：23 人有 253 对两两组合，任一对生日相同的概率累积起: Combinations grow with the square of the group size: 23 people give 253 pairs, and the accumulated chance that some pair shares a birthday approaches one half.
map.输入群体人数估算至少两人生日相同的概率，直观展示生日悖论，适合概率科普与课堂演示: Enter the group size to estimate the probability that at least two people share a birthday, showing the birthday paradox visually; good for probability education and classroom demos, entirely front-end.
map.：23 人时至少两人同生日概率≈50.7%；50 人≈97%。: : with 23 people the chance that at least two share a birthday is about 50.7%; with 50 people about 97%.
